details: A finite class has a proper empirical-risk learner whose output carries at most its log-cardinality in information.
proof: Fix a deterministic proper empirical-risk minimizer with a fixed tie-breaking order on $\mathcal H$.  Its output takes at most $|\mathcal H|$ values, hence $I(S;\mathcal A(S))\le H(\mathcal A(S))\le\log_2|\mathcal H|\le|\mathcal H|$ (with value 0 for a singleton class).  Taking the infimum in the definition of information complexity preserves this upper bound.
name: Size / Information Complexity
